variables.name: chart/primary
variables.description: Main series. Dark moved to green/300 (7.58) so chart/secondary can dim against it.

variables.name: chart/secondary
variables.description: Second series and dimmed bars on hover. 3.26 on white / 3.72 on dark surface (WCAG 1.4.11).

variables.name: chart/tertiary
variables.description: Highlight series. Light lime/600 (3.98); was 1.75.

variables.name: chart/neutral
variables.description: Comparison lines, “Other” slices, neutral progress. 4.31 on white / 6.87 on dark surface; was 1.37 / 1.41.

variables.name: chart/cat-1
variables.description: Category 1. Light green/700 (8.51) — darker than cat-2 so the pair separates by lightness, not hue alone.

variables.name: chart/cat-2
variables.description: Category 2. Light lime/600 (3.98 on white); was 2.17.

variables.name: chart/cat-3
variables.description: Validated categorical slot (CVD ΔE≥14, light+dark). Fixed order, never cycled; 4th+ series fold into chart/neutral "Other".

variables.name: bg/accent-hover
variables.description: Accent button hover. Light rest lime/300 → hover lime/400; Dark rest lime/400 → hover lime/300.

variables.name: bg/accent-pressed
variables.description: Accent button pressed. text/on-accent stays ≥ 6:1.

variables.name: bg/critical-hover
variables.description: Critical button hover + pressed. White text 8.26:1.

variables.name: text/on-critical
variables.description: Text on bg/critical. 5.69:1 on red/600.

variables.name: text/inverse-accent
variables.description: Action text on bg/inverse surfaces (Toast). Light 11.80:1 on neutral/900, Dark 8.51:1 on white. Replaces the proposed text/accent, whose modes were inverted (2.04 / 1.47).

variables.name: icon/info
variables.description: Alert Info icon. Light 6.01 on bg/info-subtle, Dark 4.65 on bg/hover.

variables.name: border/control
variables.description: Edges of inputs, selects, checkboxes, radios, switch-off track. ≥ 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11).

variables.name: border/control-hover
variables.description: Hover edge of form controls.

variables.name: chart/warning
variables.description: Progress Warning fill. 3.22 / 5.50 on chart/track.

variables.name: chart/critical
variables.description: Progress Critical fill. 3.77 / 3.11 on chart/track.

variables.name: chart/success
variables.description: Progress / Meter Success fill. 4.07 / 5.87 on chart/track.

variables.name: bg/scrim
variables.description: Modal / drawer backdrop. neutral/900 @ 32% (Light), black @ 60% (Dark).

variables.name: bg/code
variables.description: Code surfaces. Always dark in both modes.

variables.name: bg/code-elevated
variables.description: Active tab / pressed state on code surfaces.

variables.name: text/code
variables.description: Text and icons on bg/code (≥ 15:1).

variables.name: text/code-muted
variables.description: Prompts, inactive tabs, comments on bg/code (≥ 6:1).

variables.name: text/on-dark
variables.description: Text on surfaces that are dark in both modes (dark shaders, photography scrims). White in Light and Dark.

variables.name: duration/fade
variables.description: Opacity-only fades; survives Reduced motion (Q34).

variables.name: duration/pulse
variables.description: Skeleton / indeterminate progress loop; stops in Reduced.

variables.name: scale/enter
variables.description: Overlay enter scale (Dropdown, Popover); none in Reduced.

variables.name: duration/spin
variables.description: One spinner rotation (linear). 0 in Reduced: the spinner stops and a text label shows.

textStyles.name: Nizivo/Numeric/Display
textStyles.description: Tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums). Animate with count-up, duration/count-up.

textStyles.name: Nizivo/Numeric/KPI
textStyles.description: Tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums). Animate with count-up, duration/count-up.

textStyles.name: Nizivo/Numeric/L

textStyles.name: Nizivo/Numeric/M
textStyles.description: Tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums). Animate with count-up, duration/count-up.

textStyles.name: Nizivo/Body/S
textStyles.description: Captions, helper text, table meta. 12px — text tokens must still reach 4.5:1.

effectStyles.name: Nizivo/Focus/Ring
effectStyles.description: Keyboard focus. 2 px gap (bg/surface) + 2 px border/focus outline (≥ 3:1) + soft halo. Never remove; pair with :focus-visible.

effectStyles.name: Nizivo/Focus/Ring Critical
effectStyles.description: Focus on an invalid field: outline stays green, only the halo turns red.

effectStyles.name: Nizivo/Focus/Ring Raised
effectStyles.description: Focus for raised buttons (Primary, Critical, Accent): keeps the inner highlight and drop shadow, adds the focus ring.
